FREE SPINS
 Hit 3 SCATTER symbols to trigger the FREE SPINS feature and win 10 free spins.
 The MONEY and TRAIN MONEY symbol collection feature is also possible during the round.
 The feature cannot be retriggered.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.

features.name: Money Symbol
features.effects:
COLLECTION
 This is the MONEY symbol.
 It can appear on reels 1, 2, 3 and 4.
 Whenever it hits it takes a random value from a predefined set.
 Possible values are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x or 15x total bet.

 These are the TRAIN MONEY symbols.

 These are the COLLECT and SUPER COLLECT symbols. They can hit only on reel 5.
 Whenever a COLLECT or SUPER COLLECT symbol hits along with MONEY or TRAIN MONEY symbols on
 other reels, the values of all MONEY or TRAIN MONEY symbols are collected and paid.
 The value of each TRAIN MONEY symbol is determined through a train animation of its color, with a random number of
carts, each cart carrying a random value from a predefined set. Possible values on carts are: 1x, 1.5x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x,
 8x, 20x (MINI), 50x (MINOR), 500x (MAJOR) or 5000x (GRAND), multiplied by total bet.
 When a SUPER COLLECT symbol hits along with TRAIN MONEY symbols on other reels after the values of the trains are
 determined, a new golden train animation appears with a random number of carts each carrying a 1x multiplier. After the
 animation, the amount of all TRAIN MONEY symbols on the screen are multiplied by the total multiplier and paid.

options.name: Buy Free Spins
options.effects:
BUY FEATURE
 The MONEY SYMBOL COLLECTION feature round can be instantly triggered from the
 base game by buying it for 100x current total bet.
 When buying the MONEY SYMBOL COLLECTION feature, on the triggering spin, a COLLECT
 symbol or SUPER COLLECT symbol is guaranteed to hit randomly alongside with minimum
  2 TRAIN MONEY symbols of different colors.
